content: {"paper_id":"lab-10ec9a4b941d","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"In partial label learning (PLL), each sample is associated with a group of candidate labels, among which only one label is correct.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确研究PLL：每个样本对应一组候选标签且仅一个正确，核心是候选标签集消歧。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"The key of PLL is to disambiguate the candidate label set to find the ground-truth label.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"候选标签集相对于单一真值为不精确/不完整监督，论文以该弱监督条件下的消歧为实质研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","exact_quote":"further propagate the initial dissimilarity relationships to the whole data set","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将初始不相似关系传播到整个数据集，符合扩展cannot-link/只传播不相似关系的成对约束传播定义。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"multiply the label confidence matrix by its transpose to build a second-order similarity matrix, whose elements indicate the pairwise similarity relationships of samples globally","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"显式构建样本间二阶相似矩阵与语义不相似矩阵，学习/修正样本亲和与不相似关系矩阵。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"further propagate the initial dissimilarity relationships to the whole data set by leveraging the local geometric structure of samples","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"利用样本局部几何结构传播不相似关系，对标签置信矩阵解空间施加几何一致性约束。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
